spl-nac-reporting-native-reference.modality: Native T1/T2 MRI and grouped brain source-label boundaries
spl-nac-reporting-native-reference.title: Brain reporting relationships in native MRI and exact source boundaries
spl-nac-reporting-native-reference.caption: Explore 217 source classes in thirteen relationship groups, with 205 additions to the earlier twelve-structure reference. Locate each class in native axial, coronal and sagittal T1/T2, compare source objects, and inspect retained small components. Exact categorical-cell geometry preserves the source; missing capsule limbs, separate callosal segments, cisterns, vascular territories and unacquired sulcal curves remain explicit. This single-subject source does not establish diagnostic accuracy or complete reporting anatomy.

Source commit bec24db25aad5f7600e2df3becfb1f883e61ff56. Original native MRI and categorical label samples are retained. Primer’s marked adaptation derives exact label-cell boundaries and adds grouped native-image relationship controls, preserving source components without fitted registration or cleanup. Full original source notices and licensing terms accompany the reference.
